sections.title: Source health
sections.sql: select name,owner,status,next_due,pending,overdue_tasks from source_health order by name

sections.title: Open follow-ups
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_date from tasks where status='open' order by due_date

sections.title: Changed records
sections.sql: select source,record_key,change,decision,missing_fields from changed_records order by source,record_key

sections.title: Review calendar
sections.sql: select name,owner,permission_until,retention_review from sources order by permission_until

sections.title: Record gaps
sections.sql: select name,rule,finding from compliance_gaps order by name,rule
